parsed.notes:
Sections: 'PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS' sets required; 'Preferred Qualifications' sets nice_to_have.
Degree fields (machine learning, mathematics, statistics) describe the degree, not separate skills, so machine-learning and statistics are not labeled.
ai-ml is labeled required because the qualifications ask for AI/ML projects and models. It is flagged because it could be read as domain experience. 'industry AI/ML experience preferred' is an industry-setting marker and does not change it.
'modern ML frameworks' is not mapped to machine-learning; only the named frameworks are labeled. PyTorch, JAX and TensorFlow form group 1 ('PyTorch or JAX/TensorFlow').
agents is taken from 'agentic automation' and flagged, because the alias match is loose.
Terraform/CDK and Streamlit/Gradio are not grouped: CDK and Gradio have no taxonomy id, and a group needs two mapped skills.
Argo in a workflow-orchestration list is read as Argo Workflows, not Argo CD, so it is unmapped.
The preferred 'Breadth across domains such as …' list is not treated as alternatives: it asks for breadth across several domains.
Degree: 'Master’s, or PhD' takes the highest level named, phd.
